# Rumble

5 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit), 1 premium (10) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/rumble/channel/videos - 1 credit (standard)

List videos for a Rumble channel

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns channel metadata, videos, shorts, and a numeric cursor for the next page. Pass either `handle` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Rumble channel handle. · e.g. `CuteCats223`
- `url` (optional, string) - Rumble channel URL.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response — the next page number (e.g. `2`).

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/channel/videos?handle=CuteCats223" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/search - 1 credit (standard)

Search Rumble videos

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Searches Rumble videos by keyword. Returns matching videos and shorts with title, URL, thumbnail, channel, published date, view-count text + integer, plus a numeric cursor for the next page.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search query. · e.g. `funny cats`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response — the next page number (e.g. `2`).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/search?query=funny cats" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Rumble video

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns title, description, thumbnail, channel, publish date, view count, likes, dislikes, captions, and media metadata when available.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v79xhhm-discovery-example.html`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video?url=https://rumble.com/v79xhhm-discovery-example.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video/comments - 1 credit (standard)

List top-level comments on a Rumble video

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 300s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** CommentList · **Pagination** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

Returns all top-level comments for a Rumble video — comment text, author, `createdAt`, `createdAtText`, `likeCount`, `dislikeCount`, and `replyCount` when comment bodies are public.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v792vns-example.html`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/comments?url=https://rumble.com/v792vns-example.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video/transcript - 10 credits (premium)

Get a Rumble video transcript

**Cost** 10 credits (premium) · **Cache** 2592000s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Transcript · **Pagination** none

Returns the transcript for a Rumble video when captions are available. If Rumble doesn't expose captions, `transcript` is `null` and credits are not deducted.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v784xoi-president-donald-j.-trump-and-secwar-pete-hegseth-hold-a-press-conference-a.html`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/transcript?url=https://rumble.com/v784xoi-president-donald-j.-trump-and-secwar-pete-hegseth-hold-a-press-conference-a.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
